evals.prompt: I have our monthly expenses: rent 1200, food 450, transport 150, fun 200. Pie chart or bar chart?
evals.expected_output: Recommends a pie or doughnut because the four values are parts of one whole with few slices, with one reason, and rejects the bar with one line. Hands off to a sibling skill.
assertions: Gives one recommended chart type, not a menu
States the reason using the parts-of-a-whole shape or the slice count
Mentions at least one rejected alternative with a reason
Names a sibling skill such as make-a-pie-chart-with-percentages as the next step

evals.prompt: I want a pie chart of website visits by month for the whole year, 12 months.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the pie: months are a time series and 12 slices is too many. Recommends a line or bar. Explains.
assertions: Says the data is over time or has too many slices
Recommends a line graph or a bar chart
